subject: Private deployment: isolation readiness architecture review
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@aurelion.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@aurelion.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: private deployment architecture review (isolation, air-gap, on-prem)

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We'd like to schedule a technical deep-dive with Redwood to validate our isolation and air-gapped plans for the on-prem deployment. High level:

- We plan to host the inference runtime in our corporate datacenter (Colo) behind an internal-only VLAN.
- Strict egress controls, no outbound internet from the inference VLAN.
- We need to understand disk encryption, key management (KMS on-prem vs HSM), software update/workflow mechanics for models, and patching windows (we have a scheduled maintenance window 4/17-4/19).

Ideal session: 60–90 minutes with your infra/security engineer, someone who knows the deployment automation, and a product person who can walk through the rollback/fallback behavior. Can you share:

1) Two proposed slots this week or next (our timezone PST).
2) Any pre-read or checklist you want us to fill out.
3) A short list of questions we should prepare answers for (network, firewall rules, air-gap update cadence).

Attaching our current network diagram and a short inventory of the proposed hosts.

[Attachment: aurelion-current-network.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: prelim-network-questions.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Thanks — looking forward to getting this locked in.

— Sanjay Rao
VP Engineering, Aurelion Therapeutics
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@aurelion.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@aurelion.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deployment architecture review (isolation, air-gap, on-prem)

Hi Sanjay — great summary, thanks.

We can run this as a 75-minute technical review: 45 minutes for architecture + 30 minutes for Q&A and action items. Proposed agenda:

• Introductions & goals (5m)
• Network and isolation details (15m)
• Key management & secrets lifecycle (10m)
• Update and patching approach for air-gapped systems (10m)
• Rollback/fallback and monitoring (10m)
• Open Q&A / next steps (25m)

Two slots that work for our engineering leads (PST):
1) Tue Apr 6, 2027 — 10:00–11:15 PT
2) Wed Apr 7, 2027 — 14:00–15:15 PT

Pre-reads attached:
- redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf (deploy checklist + roles)
- airgap-ops-playbook.pdf (how we recommend pushing updates in isolated environments)

Please share which slot you prefer and any specific teammates who should join. Also, could you fill out the short inventory in prelim-network-questions.xlsx before the call — helps us tailor the discussion.

[Attachment: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf]
[Attachment: airgap-ops-playbook.pdf]

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@aurelion.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: (internal) Quick sync before Tue's call — Aurelion (DL-98743)

Folks — looping you in. Aurelion wants a focused run-through on network isolation and air-gap operational model. Notes / asks: 

- Lauren: can you lead the network section and confirm our recommended firewall rules + port list? Keep it high level (they'll share the diagram).
- Vivek: can you cover KMS/HSM options and the model update flow for air-gapped installs? Key questions: offline signing, update bundle verification, and rollback behavior.
- We should avoid committing to a specific on-prem KMS product — present options and trade-offs.

I proposed Tue 4/6 10:00–11:15 PT and Wed 4/7 14:00–15:15 PT. Sanjay's team may prefer Tue AM due to their patch window.

Prep items for us: skim their aurelion-current-network.pdf, verify the preliminary questions sheet for gaps, and confirm we have the right playbooks attached. I've attached the same pre-reads I sent externally.

[Attachment: redwood-private-deploy-checklist.pdf]
[Attachment: airgap-ops-playbook.pdf]

— Mina
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@aurelion.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta@aurelion.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: private deployment architecture review (isolation, air-gap, on-prem)

Mina — thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear agenda. Tue 4/6 10:00–11:15 PT works best for us. We'll invite our security lead (Chris Park) and a systems engineer who will own the host-side work.

I'll upload the completed prelim-network-questions.xlsx to the Drive folder you shared and add Chris in the calendar invite. Can you send a calendar invite with the confirmed attendees and the pre-read links? Also, please call out any specific firewall rule examples (e.g., exact ports/protocols) in the slide deck if you have them ready — that will help our network team prep.

Drive pre-read: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAurelionPreRead
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/98743

Looking forward — see you Tue.

— Sanjay
